purpose: Open the FIRST implementation lineage of the multi-organization tenancy package, bounded to canonical DAG nodes S1 (founder traceability) and S2 (selected-organization session carrier). This addendum is INSTRUCTION_ONLY over paths: it grants the exact protected and unprotected surfaces the two implementing missions may change, and it declares the protected grant and Controller successor those missions must register. All product, schema, backfill, cookie and security semantics live in the companion execution-scope authority and in the frozen tenancy authority, and are NOT restated here.
scope_note: This addendum authorizes NO implementation code and NO schema change of its own. It changes exactly two new documentation artifacts and nothing else. It does not edit scripts/ods-scope.ts, scripts/ods-controller.ts, any test host, any migration, any prepared unit, db/hosted/baseline-manifest.ts, package.json, or any frozen or sealed artifact. The protected grant it declares is registered by the S1 implementing mission under its own branch, not by this mission - the same deferral form ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.17 and v1.0.18 used for Controller maintenance. It allocates exactly one ODS ordinal and exactly one HPO grant, and allocates no following lineage item, no migration ordinal, no prepared-unit id and no baseline-manifest position.

The 'W2' infix is the ODS grant-series counter, not an assertion of Wave2 membership. Proof by counterexample: ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.10.json holds GRANT_ID HPO-ODS-W2-11 over node_authority docs/ops/p1a/P1A_FULL_BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json, and ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.12.json holds GRANT_ID HPO-ODS-W2-13 over node_authority docs/ops/p1a/P1A_FULL_BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.1.json. No identifier of the form HPO-ODS-<domain>-nn exists anywhere in the repository, which is the falsifier that would have shown the series to be domain-scoped. FUNCTION_A_IMPLEMENTATION_PATH_GRANT.why_an_ODS_instruction_is_required: The tenancy authority is TARGET_ONLY by its own classification and allocates no path, no ordinal and no grant. Without an ODS instruction the S1 and S2 implementing missions have no authorized changed-path ceiling, and ods:scope would classify every one of their edits as unauthorized. This addendum supplies exactly that ceiling and nothing more.
FUNCTION_A_IMPLEMENTATION_PATH_GRANT.ceiling_semantics: Each list is a CEILING resolved by ods:scope against that lane's own --allow list, never a mandate. A lane may change a SUBSET. A path outside its own list fails closed, and neither lane may pass the other lane's paths to --allow.
FUNCTION_A_IMPLEMENTATION_PATH_GRANT.disjointness: MEASURED. The S1 and S2 path sets intersect in the EMPTY SET. app/(authenticated)/app/onboarding/actions.ts is assigned EXCLUSIVELY to S1; the companion authority records why S2 must not write the carrier there and why that costs no functionality.
FUNCTION_A_IMPLEMENTATION_PATH_GRANT.S3_NOT_GRANTED: No path of canonical S3 is authorized. In particular db/identity-context.ts, lib/auth/database-context.ts, lib/auth/session.ts, lib/auth/permissions.ts and lib/auth/roles.ts are NOT in either lane's ceiling. Stated affirmatively because the natural way to make the S2 carrier useful is to read it in exactly those files, and doing so would be S3 performed without S3's lineage.

FUNCTION_B_PROTECTED_GRANT.PROTECTED_GRANT_REQUIRED: YES - for the S1 lane only.
FUNCTION_B_PROTECTED_GRANT.why: MEASURED. db/migrations/** is DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS entry 4 in scripts/ods-scope.ts, and S1 must add a migration carrying organizations.founded_by, its provenance discriminator, the founder-cardinality carrier and the MO-11 backfill. No other authorized path in either lane matches any of the seven default protected patterns.
FUNCTION_B_PROTECTED_GRANT.REGISTERED_BY_THIS_MISSION: NO - DELIBERATE. Inserting the entry into the PROTECTED_GRANTS registry edits scripts/ods-scope.ts, which is a gate script. This mission is AUTHORITY_ONLY and edits no gate script. Registration is GRANTED_BY_THIS_ADDENDUM_TO_THE_S1_IMPLEMENTING_MISSION_ONLY, in the same deferral form v1.0.17 and v1.0.18 used for Controller maintenance.
FUNCTION_B_PROTECTED_GRANT.narrowing: The pattern is db/migrations/** rather than an exact ordinal because CP-1 records that db/migrations is a single global sequence contested with Wave3/FIBDB-053, CommercialAccount, Portfolio and Stella, and pinning an ordinal at freeze time manufactures the collision it is meant to avoid. The effective surface stays narrow because ods:scope additionally requires every granted path to appear in the lane's own exact --allow list - the grant alone never authorizes a diff.
FUNCTION_B_PROTECTED_GRANT.NO_PREPARED_GRANT: MEASURED AND DELIBERATE. No db/prepared/** grant of any width is issued. S1 needs no prepared unit: the founder-cardinality carrier is schema-level, and db/prepared/stella_0010_organization_bootstrap_capability.sql is DESIGN-ONLY, NOT APPLIED and absent from db/hosted/baseline-manifest.ts, so it is neither editable nor needed by this batch. A blanket db/prepared/** grant is forbidden.
FUNCTION_B_PROTECTED_GRANT.NO_BASELINE_MANIFEST_GRANT: db/hosted/baseline-manifest.ts is not authorized, because no prepared or hosted unit is added. This also keeps the batch clear of CP-3 and of the pinned manifest digest guarded by KTC-HOSTED-BASELINE-REHEARSAL-STALE-01/02.
FUNCTION_B_PROTECTED_GRANT.NO_STAGING_NO_PRODUCTION: No staging path, no production path, no Docker and no db/baseline/** is authorized.

risks_and_open_findings.F-1_wave2_closure_artifact_absent: NON-BLOCKING HERE, OPEN FOR THE WAVE2 LANE. ODS_PROGRAM_STATE_REGISTRY_v1.0.0.json defines the W2-B5 audit stage as CLOSED only when docs/ops/wave2/W2_B5_FOCUSED_ADVERSARIAL_CLOSURE_AUDIT_v1.0.0.json exists with closure.W2_B5 === 'CLOSED'. That file does not exist at INTEGRATION_SHA, so by the registry's own machine definition the stage is not closed, notwithstanding that W2-B5 implementation is integrated in merge a27c4a9. This mission reports the discrepancy rather than accepting or fabricating closure, declares nothing about W2-B5, and depends on the Controller enumeration interlock instead - which is discharged by direct measurement of the live Controller.
risks_and_open_findings.F-2_migration_ordinal_race: MITIGATED, NOT ELIMINATED. CP-1 is a global sequence. The grant deliberately does not pin an ordinal; the S1 mission allocates the next free one measured at its own start. Residual risk is a re-number, never a silent merge.
risks_and_open_findings.F-3_grant_pattern_is_a_directory_glob: ACCEPTED WITH COMPENSATION. db/migrations/** is broader than an exact file list, which HPO-ODS-W2-02 was able to use because its ordinals were already known. Compensated by the fact that ods:scope requires the lane's exact --allow list in addition to the grant, so the glob alone can never authorize a diff, and by O8-style exact-path accounting in the S1 lane's own poststate.
risks_and_open_findings.F-4_inertness_is_a_convention_until_its_: THE PRINCIPAL RESIDUAL RISK OF THE BATCH. S2's safety argument depends on nothing consuming the carrier. Until control NS2-4 is implemented, that is prose rather than a machine-checked property. The companion authority makes NS2-4 mandatory and non-waivable for exactly this reason.
risks_and_open_findings.F-5_program_state_registry_has_no_entry_: ACCEPTED. pnpm ops:program-state cannot report multi-org stage state until an entry exists. Creating one now would assert stages that have no evidence. It should be added by the first implementing mission that produces implementation evidence.
